cards.name: Arktos X - Vaylantz Game Master
cards.spec_text:
Pendulum Effect: If you control a "Vaylantz" Fusion monster: You can Special Summon this card to your Main Monster Zone in its same column. You can only use this effect of "Arktos X - Vaylantz Game Master" once per turn.
Monster Effect: Each time exactly 1 monster is Normal or Special Summoned to your opponent's field: Move this card to the adjacent Main Monster Zone closer to that opponent's monster. (Quick Effect): You can move 1 monster you control to another of your Main Monster Zones. You can only use this effect of "Arktos X - Vaylantz Game Master" once per turn.

cards.name: Terrarumian Coin Plant
cards.spec_text:
Pendulum Effect: Monsters your opponent controls lose 300 ATK for each “Terrarumian” Pendulum Monster in Defense Position. If you control a “Terrarumian” monster: You can destroy 1 other “Terrarumian” card you control, and if you do, Special Summon this card, then place 1 “Terrarumian” Pendulum Monster from your Deck to your Pendulum Zone, except “Terrarumian Coin Plant”. You can only use this effect of “Terrarumian Coin Plant” once per turn.
Monster Effect: If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can banish 1 card in your opponent’s GY, or if you control 2 or more “Terrarumian” monsters in Defense Position, you can banish 1 random card from their hand face-up, until the End Phase instead. You can only use this effect of “Terrarumian Coin Plant” once per turn. This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its ATK for damage calculation.

cards.name: Terrarumian Trumpet Pitchers
cards.spec_text:
Pendulum Effect: Your opponent cannot target “Terrarumian” monsters you control with card effects. If you control a “Terrarumian” monster: You can destroy 1 other “Terrarumian” card you control, and if you do, Special Summon this card in Defense Position, then you can Special Summon 1 face-up “Terrarumian” Pendulum Monster from your Extra Deck, except “Terrarumian Trumpet Pitchers”. You can only use this effect of “Terrarumian Trumpet Pitchers” once per turn. This card can attack while in face-up Defense Position. If it does, apply its ATK for damage calculation.
